name: switchboard
description: One local port. Any upstream. Same conversation.

commands.title: Switchboard: Switch to the next upstream
Switchboard: Set direct Anthropic API key
Switchboard: Fetch models from a platform

switchboard.activeProvider.description: Which upstream requests go to. The panel and status bar also switch this.

switchboard.listenHost.markdownDescription: Address the bridge listens on. Keep `127.0.0.1` unless you intend to expose it beyond this machine.

switchboard.listenPort.description: Local port. Keep it stable: the value is written into your Claude Code settings. Change it if another proxy already uses this port.

switchboard.autoStart.description: Start the bridge when VS Code finishes loading.

switchboard.genai.url.markdownDescription: The GenAI platform address. A base URL is enough; the API path is appended. A full endpoint URL is also accepted.

enumDescriptions: Send the token straight through as the credential.
Trade the token for a short-lived JWT first, then send that.
switchboard.genai.authMode.markdownDescription: How this platform expects to be authenticated. Choose `jwt` when it issues short-lived tokens from a refresh endpoint.

switchboard.genai.userEmail.description: Identity this platform attributes usage to. Sent in the identity header below.

switchboard.genai.environment.markdownDescription: Which entry of the environment URLs below to use, for example `DEV`, `UAT` or `PRO`. Ignored when a refresh URL is set explicitly.

switchboard.genai.environmentUrls.markdownDescription: Token exchange base URL per environment, for example `{"DEV": "https://dev.example.com/api-access", "PRO": "https://example.com/api-access"}`. These are yours to supply; none are built in.

switchboard.genai.refreshUrl.markdownDescription: Token exchange base URL, overriding the environment lookup. `/refresh` is appended.

switchboard.genai.apiShape.markdownDescription: Which API this platform speaks. `openai` translates in both directions; `anthropic` forwards with almost no translation.

switchboard.genai.modelMap.markdownDescription: Maps the model ids clients ask for onto the ids this platform serves. A key ending in `*` matches by prefix.

switchboard.genai.identityHeader.description: Header carrying the user email. Leave empty if this platform does not want one.

switchboard.genai.tenantHeader.description: Header carrying the tenant id. Leave empty if not required.

switchboard.genai.tenantId.description: Value sent in the tenant header.

switchboard.genai.authPrefix.description: Text placed before the credential. Empty for a bare token.

switchboard.genai.pathTemplate.markdownDescription: Overrides the request path. `{model}` is substituted, which suits APIs that address a deployment by model id in the URL. Leave empty for the usual paths.

switchboard.genai.extraHeaders.description: Additional static headers sent on every call to this platform.

switchboard.bedrock.url.markdownDescription: Bedrock address. A base URL is enough; the API path is appended. A full endpoint URL is also accepted.

enumDescriptions: Send the token straight through as the credential.
Trade the token for a short-lived JWT first, then send that.
switchboard.bedrock.authMode.markdownDescription: How this platform expects to be authenticated. Choose `jwt` when it issues short-lived tokens from a refresh endpoint.

switchboard.bedrock.userEmail.description: Identity this platform attributes usage to. Sent in the identity header below.

switchboard.bedrock.environment.markdownDescription: Which entry of the environment URLs below to use, for example `DEV`, `UAT` or `PRO`. Ignored when a refresh URL is set explicitly.

switchboard.bedrock.environmentUrls.markdownDescription: Token exchange base URL per environment, for example `{"DEV": "https://dev.example.com/api-access", "PRO": "https://example.com/api-access"}`. These are yours to supply; none are built in.

switchboard.bedrock.refreshUrl.markdownDescription: Token exchange base URL, overriding the environment lookup. `/refresh` is appended.

switchboard.bedrock.apiShape.markdownDescription: Which API this platform speaks. `openai` translates in both directions; `anthropic` forwards with almost no translation.

switchboard.bedrock.modelMap.markdownDescription: Maps the model ids clients ask for onto the ids this platform serves. A key ending in `*` matches by prefix.

switchboard.bedrock.identityHeader.description: Header carrying the user email. Leave empty if this platform does not want one.

switchboard.bedrock.tenantHeader.description: Header carrying the tenant id. Leave empty if not required.

switchboard.bedrock.tenantId.description: Value sent in the tenant header.

switchboard.bedrock.authPrefix.description: Text placed before the credential. Empty for a bare token.

switchboard.bedrock.pathTemplate.markdownDescription: Overrides the request path. `{model}` is substituted, which suits APIs that address a deployment by model id in the URL. Leave empty for the usual paths.

switchboard.bedrock.extraHeaders.description: Additional static headers sent on every call to this platform.

switchboard.bedrock.region.description: Region, for platforms that need one.

switchboard.includeUsage.description: Ask the platform to report token counts. Turn off if it rejects the stream_options field.

switchboard.forceNonStreaming.description: Always request a whole response and synthesise the streaming events locally.

switchboard.verbose.description: Log translated request bodies. Credentials are always redacted.

scripts.reinstall: npm run compile && npx @vscode/vsce package && code --install-extension switchboard-0.2.0.vsix --force
scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test test/adapter.test.js test/claudeConfig.test.js test/token.test.js test/log.test.js test/config.test.js
